title: Incomplete interaction states
summary: Adds a Customers page whose DataTable has no status and no empty state, so loading, empty and error states are missing.
whyItMatters: Missing states pass every happy-path demo and fail real users. The component contract makes the omission objectively detectable.

expected.note: Provenance relates the page to existing list and dashboard pages (a variation of an established pattern), which is informational.
